stock.description: Langham Hospitality Investments Limited operates as an investment holding enterprise primarily engaged in real estate ventures across Hong Kong. The company's portfolio encompasses ownership and investments in a variety of hotel properties, notably branded as The Langham, Hong Kong, Cordis, Hong Kong, and Eaton HK. As of December 31, 2021, it oversaw the management of 26 hotels. Beyond its core property activities, the firm also delivers administrative, financial, and treasury management provisions. Established in 2013, its corporate base is located in Wanchai, Hong Kong. Langham Hospitality Investments Limited functions as a subsidiary of LHIL Assets Holdings Limited.
